lines.text: Solomon stands before the altar in front of all Israel, spreads his hands toward heaven, and says no God is like the LORD.
Solomon says God fulfilled His promise to David and asks Him to keep the promise that David would never lack a man on the throne.
Solomon says the highest heavens cannot contain God, yet asks Him to hear prayers prayed toward the temple from Zion, His dwelling place.
Solomon pictures sinning Israel taken captive by an enemy, then repenting, and he asks God to grant them strength before their captors.

wrong_details.true: compassion in the eyes of their captors

lines.text: Solomon says God brought Israel out of Egypt and set them apart as His inheritance, as He spoke through Moses.
